XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: Abnormal activation of indicators, unintentional opening/closing of driver's side windows
XDOCUMENTO.InfoDoc: LIGHTING | ELECTRONICS | BODY | COMPUTER | WINDOW | GLASS | DRIVER | OPENS | CLOSES | INDICATORS | FOUR | EMERGENCY | LIGHTS | SIGNALLERS | CONNECTORS | CONNECTIONS |

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: Body computer

  • Fault: When closing the driver's side window, the hazard warning lights activate abnormally. Similarly, when the window is open, activating the hazard warning lights causes the window to close automatically.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: Oxidised connections on the back of the body computer

• Action: Check the condition of the body computer connections and restore them if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: In the case in question, oxidised contacts were detected on connectors M01 and M02 of the body computer, responsible respectively for the BCM power supply (with management of digital inputs and light/switch outputs) and the CAN network (for closures, external lights and comfort/safety sensors). After restoring the contacts, the fault was resolved.
